Mira Labs is excited to announce our inaugural WCA competition, **Mira Labs Cubing Scientists in Bacolod 2025**!

This event welcomes participants of all ages and skill levels, with generous cut-off times to encourage broader participation. The 3x3x3 cube, our main event, will feature three thrilling rounds, while the 2x2x2 cube will have two rounds. To revive the community’s interest in specialized categories, we’re also offering two rounds for Clock and Square-1, while the remaining events will each feature a single, intense round.

By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this event.

Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event.
